fact: ARCOP stated on 3 December 2025 that all public procurement procedures in Senegal will soon be exclusively online, with 52 pilot contracting authorities using APPEL since 15 October 2025 and suppliers invited to submit bids only electronically.
title: Fournisseurs, consultants, acteurs économiques : préparez-vous à participer aux appels d'offres 100 % en ligne
